faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before applying.

who.q: Who can become a FOVE sales partner?
who.a: The program is open to any person or organization with a professional network of merchants: agencies, freelancers, developers, retail consultants, merchant associations or business referrers.

attribution.a: Each partner has a personal link (e.g. https://fove.digital/p/YOURCODE). When a merchant clicks your link, a 30-day first-party cookie is set. If they sign up within that window, their business is permanently linked to you in our database.

base.q: What amount is the commission based on?
base.a: The commission is 20% of the amount actually collected by FOVE (excluding taxes and after any promotional coupons). It applies from the first paid subscription.

withdraw.q: When and how can I withdraw my earnings?
withdraw.a: As soon as your available commission balance reaches the minimum threshold of $50 or €50 (depending on your currency), you can request a payout directly from your partner space. We pay by bank transfer or Mobile Money (Airtel Money, Orange Money, M-Pesa depending on availability in your area).

fees.q: Are there any fees or commitments?
fees.a: No, joining the FOVE partner program is 100% free, with no entry fee and no mandatory quota.

both.q: Can I be both a FOVE merchant and a partner?
both.a: Absolutely. Your single FOVE user account gives you easy access to both your merchant space (/app) and your partner space (/partner).

No app to download, push notification reminders, and you double repeat visits from your best customers in the very first month.”

resources.objectionsTitle: Answers to the 3 most common objections
resources.answerPaper: In reality, 70% of customers forget their paper card. Their smartphone, on the other hand, is always in their pocket when it’s time to pay.
resources.answerPrice: The Essentiel plan is only $99 a year (less than $9 a month). Just one extra loyal customer a week pays for the investment.
resources.objectionTime: “I don’t have time to set it up”
